title.zh: 使用原生Prompt调用通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用
title.en: Invoke the Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI-Dialogue Analysis AIO application using a native prompt

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO产品的收费方式和价格。

前提条件
1. 已开通通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO服务。
2. 已创建应用：应用中心完成通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用创建，并获取到APP-ID和WORKSPACE-ID：[获取APP-ID和WORKSPACE-ID](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html?spm=a2c4g.2782164.0.0.2b2b6dcdZZ5oUE)。
descriptions.en:
Before you use this API, make sure you understand the billing methods and pricing of the Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI-Conversation Analysis AIO product.

Prerequisites

1. Activate the Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI-Conversation Analysis AIO service.

2. Create a Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI-Conversation Analysis AIO application in the Application Center to obtain an APP-ID and a WORKSPACE-ID. For more information, see [the referenced document](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html?spm=a2c4g.2782164.0.0.2b2b6dcdZZ5oUE).
